From Delhi to small-town India, millions are unknowingly drinking water mixed with their own sewage. Sounds unbelievable? It’s happening.

A deadly combo of broken sewage systems, poor infrastructure, and zero accountability means untreated waste is leaking into water pipelines. Lakes are foaming, rivers are toxic, and groundwater is no longer safe. Add to that corrupt contractors, ignored reports, and years of neglect—and you’ve got a full-blown public health disaster.

In this video, we expose how India’s water crisis is not just about scarcity, but about the filth we’ve allowed into our own systems.
